system.description:
Can be acquired at CR16 or higher. You gain the [Fairy] and [Cold] tags. +[SR×7] to the damage rolls of your attacks with the [Cold] tag. (Guaranteed Effect) Deal [INT] direct damage to a secondary target within "Target: Single / Range: 4 Sq." of you.

A skill that allows the user to summon Undine, a water fairy with a beautiful maiden's appearance, and bind a high-level contract to command it. The enhanced water flow and cold air drain all heat from enemies.
